lines.say: First, Israel at true size: 22,072 square kilometres.
The West Bank and Gaza are shaded. Not counted.
Pick it up, and drop it on Jordan. Jordan holds four Israels.
Syria, just over eight. Now it gets bigger.
Egypt? One. Two. Three. Egypt holds 45 Israels.
Saudi Arabia? About 100. A hundred Israels in one country.
Now the whole Arab League, from Morocco to Oman.
593 Israels. Every copy at true size.
Size isn't everything. But it explains why every kilometre here matters.
Which country should I drop Israel on next?

caption_en:
The last number is the one nobody believes. 🗺️

Israel at true size: 22,072 km², incl. the Golan Heights and East Jerusalem (Israel Central Bureau of Statistics, 2023). The West Bank and Gaza are shaded on the map and not counted.

How many times it fits (total surface area, UN Statistics Division, Demographic Yearbook 2024):
🇯🇴 Jordan 89,318 km²: 4x
🇸🇾 Syria 185,180 km²: 8.4x
🇪🇬 Egypt 1,002,000 km²: 45x
🇸🇦 Saudi Arabia 2,206,714 km²: 100x (other sources list 2,149,690 km², about 97x)
Arab League: 593x (21 member states, 13.09 million km²; Sudan from the CIA World Factbook; Morocco without Western Sahara; adding the State of Palestine, 6,020 km², still gives 593).

Every copy of Israel is drawn at true size for its latitude, on an equal area map (no Mercator stretch).

Size isn't everything. But it explains why every kilometre here matters.
Which country should I drop Israel on next?

Part 1 of 4: the USA, Europe and the whole world are next.

caption_he: כמה פעמים ישראל נכנסת לשכנות שלה? ישראל בגודל אמיתי: 22,072 קמ״ר כולל רמת הגולן ומזרח ירושלים (הלמ״ס). יהודה ושומרון ועזה מסומנים בגוון אחר ולא נספרו. ירדן: פי 4. סוריה: פי 8.4. מצרים: פי 45. סעודיה: בערך פי 100. כל הליגה הערבית: פי 593. גודל זה לא הכול, אבל זה מסביר למה כל קילומטר כאן חשוב. על איזו מדינה להפיל את ישראל בפעם הבאה?
